# Session and navigation

Sessions starting and ending, and pages being viewed.

[All domains](README.md)

## `home_page_viewed`

The storefront home page was viewed.

**Sources:** browser · **Version:** 1

No fields are required beyond the envelope.

Other fields come from the `commerce` block.

## `page_viewed`

Any page was viewed. Single-page apps report one per route change.

**Sources:** browser · **Version:** 1

No fields are required beyond the envelope.

Other fields come from the `commerce` block.

## `session_ended`

The browsing session ended, through inactivity or logout.

**Sources:** browser · **Version:** 1

No fields are required beyond the envelope.

Other fields come from the `commerce` block.

## `session_started`

A new browsing session began, on the first visit or after the inactivity timeout.

**Sources:** browser · **Version:** 1 · **Autocaptured**

No fields are required beyond the envelope.

Other fields come from the `commerce` block.
